service.ur: خروج کے اجازت نامے کی منسوخی

about: Cancel a departure permit that was issued earlier, for residents or visitors.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Exit permit cancellation. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The person's status in the country has to be amended
A departure permit must have been issued first
documents: Other papers only if ICP cannot fetch them from government records
fees: Fine 50 AED a day from the 8th day after the permit expires or is cancelled
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
